arxiv-2012-08310.title: On the finite generation of fiber ring of invariant jet differentials
arxiv-2012-08310.creator: Mohammad Reza Rahmati
arxiv-2012-08310.description: Abstract . We consider invariant jet differentials, in complex hyperbolicity. The main result of this paper concerns the finite generation of the ring of invariant k k -jets as a generalization of a conjecture which was first mentioned in [ 13 ] and later studied in [ 1 , 11 , 12 , 21 ] .

arxiv-2105-13760.title: Quantum repeater protocol using an arrangement of QED-optomechanical hybrid systems
arxiv-2105-13760.creator: M K Tavassoly
arxiv-2105-13760.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by M K Tavassoly. In this paper we consider the quantum repeater protocol for distributing the entanglement to two distant three-level atoms. In this protocol, we insert six atoms between two target atoms such that the eight considered atoms are labeled by 1 , 2 , ⋯ 8 1,2,\cdots 8 , while only each two adjacent atoms ( i , i + 1 ) (i,i+1) with i = 1 , 3 , 5 , 7 i=1,3,5,7 are entangled.

arxiv-2107-01422.title: Imaging dynamics beneath turbid media via parallelized single-photon detection
arxiv-2107-01422.creator: Shiqi Xu, Xi Yang, Wenhui Liu, Joakim Jonsson, Ruobing Qian, Pavan Chandra Konda, Kevin C. Zhou, Lucas Kreiss, Qionghai Dai, Haoqian Wang, Edouard Berrocal, Roarke Horstmeyer
arxiv-2107-01422.description: Abstract Noninvasive optical imaging through dynamic scattering media has numerous important biomedical applications but still remains a challenging task. While standard diffuse imaging methods measure optical absorption or fluorescent emission, it is also well-established that the temporal correlation of scattered coherent light diffuses through tissue much like optical intensity.

arxiv-2205-10304.title: Dark Z Z at the International Linear Collider
arxiv-2205-10304.description: Abstract A dark Z Z is a massive Abelian gauge boson which is coupled to the Standard Model through both kinetic and mass mixing with the electroweak sector. We study the phenomenology of the dark Z Z at an energy-frontier e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} collider, such as the proposed International Linear Collider ( ILC ).

arxiv-2212-12669.title: On Realization of Intelligent Decision-Making in the Real World: A Foundation Decision Model Perspective
arxiv-2212-12669.creator: Ying Wen ying.wen@sjtu.edu.cn, Ziyu Wanalex_wan@sjtu.edu.cn, Ming Zhou mingak@sjtu.edu.cn, Shufang Hou shufang.hou@digitalbrain.cn, Zhe Cao caozheoldpaws@sjtu.edu.cn, Chenyang Le nethermanpro@sjtu.edu.cn, Jingxiao Chen timemachine@sjtu.edu.cn, Zheng Tian zheng.tian@shanghaitech.edu.cn, Weinan Zhang
arxiv-2212-12669.description: Abstract The pervasive uncertainty and dynamic nature of real-world environments present significant challenges for the widespread implementation of machine-driven Intelligent Decision-Making (IDM) systems. Consequently, IDM should possess the ability to continuously acquire new skills and effectively generalize across a broad range of applications.

arxiv-2310-20335.title: Uplifting edges in higher order networks: spectral centralities for non-uniform hypergraphs
arxiv-2310-20335.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . Spectral analysis of networks states that many structural properties of graphs, such as centrality of their nodes, are given in terms of their adjacency matrices. The natural extension of such spectral analysis to higher order networks is strongly limited by the fact that a given hypergraph could have several different adjacency hypermatrices, hence the results obtained so far are mainly restricted to the class of uniform hypergraphs, which leaves many real systems unattended.

arxiv-2402-00898.title: An Early Categorization of Prompt Injection Attacks on Large Language Models
arxiv-2402-00898.creator: Sippo Rossi, Alisia Marianne Michel, Raghava Rao Mukkamala, Jason Bennett Thatcher
arxiv-2402-00898.description: Abstract Large language models and AI chatbots have been at the forefront of democratizing artificial intelligence. However, the releases of ChatGPT and other similar tools have been followed by an increasing number of concerns regarding the difficulty of controlling large language models and their outputs.

arxiv-2407-07018.title: End-To-End Causal Effect Estimation from Unstructured Natural Language Data
arxiv-2407-07018.creator: Nikita Dhawan, Leonardo Cotta, Karen Ullrich, Rahul G. Krishnan, Chris J. Maddison
arxiv-2407-07018.description: Abstract Knowing the effect of an intervention is critical for human decision-making, but current approaches for causal effect estimation rely on manual data collection and structuring, regardless of the causal assumptions. This increases both the cost and time-to-completion for studies.

arxiv-2408-12262.title: Black hole X-ray spectra: notes on the relativistic calculations
arxiv-2408-12262.creator: Cosimo Bambi
arxiv-2408-12262.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Cosimo Bambi. This is a collection of notes to calculate electromagnetic spectra of geometrically thin and optically thick accretion disks around black holes. The presentation is intentionally pedagogical and most calculations are reported step by step. In the disk-corona model, the spectrum of a source has three components: a thermal component from the disk, a Comptonized component from the corona, and a reflection component from the disk. These notes review only the relativistic calculations.

arxiv-2410-00244.title: Multi-threshold time series analysis enables characterization of variable renewable energy droughts in Europe
arxiv-2410-00244.creator: Martin Kittel, Wolf-Peter Schill
arxiv-2410-00244.description: Abstract Variable renewable energy droughts, so called Dunkelflaute events, emerge as a challenge for climate-neutral energy systems based on variable renewables. Here we characterize European drought events for on- and offshore wind power, solar photovoltaics, and renewable technology portfolios, using 38 historic weather years and an advanced identification method.

arxiv-2410-13217.creator: Ruohan Wang, Zilong Wang, Ziyang Song, David Buckeridge, Yue Li
arxiv-2410-13217.description: Abstract . Automatic subphenotyping from electronic health records (EHRs) provides numerous opportunities to understand diseases with unique subgroups and enhance personalized medicine for patients. However, existing machine learning algorithms either focus on specific diseases for better interpretability or produce coarse-grained phenotype topics without considering nuanced disease patterns.

arxiv-2410-23290.title: Exceptional Collections for Toric Fano Fourfolds
arxiv-2410-23290.creator: Jumari Querimit Ramirez, Yang (Hill) Zhang, Justin Son, and Reginald Anderson
arxiv-2410-23290.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jumari Querimit Ramirez, Yang (Hill) Zhang, Justin Son, and Reginald Anderson. Beilinson first gave a resolution of the diagonal for ℙ n \mathbb{P}^{n} . Generalizing this, a modification of the cellular resolution of the diagonal given by Bayer-Popescu- Sturmfels gives a (non-minimal, in general) virtual resolution of the diagonal for smooth projective toric varieties and toric Deligne-Mumford stacks which are a global quotient of a smooth projective variety by a finite abelian group.

arxiv-2502-09441.title: Multiwavelength investigations of PKS 2300 − - 18: S-shaped radio quasar with precessing jets and double-peaked broad emission-line spectrum
arxiv-2502-09441.creator: Arpita Misra, Marek Jamrozy, Marek Weżgowiec, Dorota Kozieł-Wierzbowska
arxiv-2502-09441.description: Abstract S-shaped radio galaxy jets are prime sources for investigating the dynamic interplay between the central active galactic nucleus, the jets, and the ambient intergalactic medium. These sources are excellent candidates for studying jet precession, as their S-shaped inversion symmetry strongly indicates underlying precession.

arxiv-2508-03089.title: Li-enrichment in red clump giants: Clues for past binary interaction or merger events
arxiv-2508-03089.creator: Raghubar Singh, Bacham E. Reddy, Anohita Mallick, Gang Zhao
arxiv-2508-03089.description: Abstract To understand the underlying mechanisms for high lithium abundances among core He-burning or red clump (RC) giants, we analyzed a sample of 5227 RC giants of mass M ≤ \leq 2 M ⊙ using spectra and asteroseismic data. We found 120 RC giants ( ∼ \sim 2 % \% ) with a lower limit of A(Li) = 0.

arxiv-2509-21729.title: New Parallel and Streaming Algorithms for Directed Densest Subgraph
arxiv-2509-21729.creator: Slobodan Mitrović, Theodore Pan, Mahdi Qaempanah, Mohammad Amin Raeisi
arxiv-2509-21729.description: Abstract Finding dense subgraphs is a fundamental problem with applications to community detection, clustering, and data mining. Our work focuses on finding approximate densest subgraphs in directed graphs in computational models for processing massive data. We consider two such models: Massively Parallel Computation (MPC) and semi-streaming.

pmc-12610013.title: Treatment Patterns by Physiologic Age in Older Adults with Early-Stage Breast Cancer: A Single Institution Retrospective Study
pmc-12610013.creator: Eliza H. Lorentzen, Yu-Jen Chen, Maria Harvey, Christina A. Minami

pmc-13669948.title: Endoscopic diagnosis and management of biliary neuroendocrine tumor with prior Roux-en-Y choledochojejunostomy: a case report
pmc-13669948.creator: Alec Hope, Hasib Ahmadzai, Philip Ian Craig
pmc-13669948.description: A 74-year-old woman with a previous Roux-en-Y choledochojejunostomy presented with biliary sepsis, Escherichia coli bacteremia, and a left-sided intrahepatic biliary stricture. Initial management included percutaneous transhepatic cholangiography with external biliary drainage. Colonoscope-directed cholangioscopy enabled biopsies and balloon dilatation because of the colonoscope's suitable length and channel diameter. Histology revealed a poorly differentiated neuroendocrine tumor of the bile duct.
